description: Labelled developer memories and queries for the memory retrieval regression benchmark. Memory ids are fixture-local; the test maps them to registered node ids.

memories.title: Package manager
memories.body: Always use pnpm instead of npm or yarn for JavaScript projects.

memories.title: Indentation style
memories.body: Prefers two-space indentation in TypeScript and four spaces in Python; never tabs.

memories.title: Commit messages
memories.body: Write conventional commit messages such as feat(scope) or fix(scope) with an imperative summary.

memories.title: No emoji
memories.body: Do not put emoji in code comments, commit messages, or pull request descriptions.

memories.title: Editor
memories.body: Uses Neovim with the LazyVim distribution and rust-analyzer for Rust work.

memories.title: Timezone
memories.body: Works from Tel Aviv, timezone Asia/Jerusalem; standups happen at 10:00 local time.

memories.title: Code review style
memories.body: Wants review comments grouped by severity: blocking bugs first, then nits.

memories.title: Shell
memories.body: Default shell is zsh on macOS and PowerShell 7 on the Windows workstation.

memories.title: Tests before fixes
memories.body: Reproduce a bug with a failing regression test before changing production code.

memories.title: Dependencies
memories.body: Avoid adding new third-party dependencies when the standard library can do the job.

memories.title: Desktop stack
memories.body: The desktop app is Tauri 2 with a Vite, React, and TypeScript frontend and an embedded Axum server.

memories.title: Desktop verification
memories.body: Run pnpm -C apps/desktop verify before opening a desktop pull request.

memories.title: Rust lint
memories.body: Lint the workspace with cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets and treat warnings as errors.

memories.title: Docs site
memories.body: The documentation site is a Vite React app deployed to Cloudflare Pages and imports docs/wiki markdown.

memories.title: Run ledger
memories.body: Provider requests are stored byte for byte in the run ledger so a model step can be replayed later.

memories.title: Privacy gate
memories.body: Remote providers pass through the privacy gate; Block mode refuses PII and Redact mode swaps it for placeholders.

memories.title: Control API
memories.body: Desktop chats are driven through /control/v1 commands like thread.create and turn.send with a paired device key.

memories.title: MCP is read-only
memories.body: The milim mcp bridge exposes read-only tools; mutations must run through an agent with approval.

memories.title: E2E platform
memories.body: The WebDriver end-to-end suite only runs on Windows because WKWebView has no WebDriver.

memories.title: Release preparation
memories.body: Prepare a release by bumping VERSION, updating the changelog, and tagging vX.Y.Z on main.

memories.title: Approval modes
memories.body: Tool approval has three modes: review asks for every consequential call, guarded auto-approves safe calls, open approves everything.

memories.title: Storage engine
memories.body: User data lives in SQLite through rusqlite with numbered migrations; never edit an applied migration.

memories.title: Billing database
memories.body: The billing API uses PostgreSQL 16 with sqlx; migrations live in db/migrations and run on deploy.

memories.title: Payment provider
memories.body: Stripe is the payment processor; webhook signatures are verified with the STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET variable.

memories.title: Idempotency keys
memories.body: Every invoice creation endpoint requires an Idempotency-Key header to make client retries safe.

memories.title: Money representation
memories.body: Store money as integer minor units (cents) with an ISO 4217 currency code; never use floats.

memories.title: Billing tests
memories.body: Run the billing test suite with make test, which starts a disposable Postgres container first.

memories.title: On-call rotation
memories.body: Billing on-call rotates weekly on Mondays; the pager escalation goes to the payments team lead.

memories.title: Invoice PDFs
memories.body: Invoice PDFs are rendered by a headless Chromium worker and cached in the S3 bucket billing-invoices.

memories.title: Sales tax
memories.body: Sales tax and VAT are calculated by the tax service before an invoice is finalized.

memories.title: Infrastructure as code
memories.body: All cloud resources are managed with Terraform 1.8; state is stored in an encrypted S3 backend with DynamoDB locking.

memories.title: Cluster
memories.body: Services run on a Kubernetes cluster in eu-central-1 and deploy through Argo CD from the gitops repository.

memories.title: Secrets management
memories.body: Secrets come from AWS Secrets Manager via the external-secrets operator; never commit .env files.

memories.title: Alerting
memories.body: Prometheus alerts route through Alertmanager to the #ops-alerts Slack channel and PagerDuty.

memories.title: Database backups
memories.body: Nightly database snapshots are retained for 35 days and restore drills run every quarter.

memories.title: CI runners
memories.body: GitHub Actions uses self-hosted macOS runners for Apple builds and hosted Ubuntu runners for everything else.

memories.title: DNS
memories.body: DNS zones are hosted on Cloudflare and TLS certificates are issued by cert-manager with Let's Encrypt.

memories.title: Cost controls
memories.body: Non-production clusters scale to zero overnight to reduce cloud cost.

memories.title: Logging
memories.body: Application logs ship to Loki through Promtail and are kept for 14 days.

memories.title: Node version
memories.body: Build images pin Node 22 LTS and Python 3.12 for tooling scripts.
